opportunities.name: npm package research to Notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, look up its version and weekly downloads on npmjs.com, open its GitHub repo for stars, open issues and the last release, then save a one-line summary in the Notes app.
steps: Open npmjs.com and type {package} in the search box
Open the exact-match package from the autocomplete list or the results page
Record the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the Repository link to open the GitHub repo
Record the stars, open issues and the latest release date
Open the Notes app, click 'New note' and type '{package}: v{version}, {downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {issues} open issues, last release {date}'
Save the note

instances.values: axios (picked @nestjs/axios by mistake at first, then the real axios) -> v1.20.0, 96,527,621/week, MIT, 109k stars

opportunities.name: Movie night invite with IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings
opportunities.description: For a given movie, friend and day, get the IMDb rating, director and runtime plus the Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer score, then write a movie-night email to the friend.
opportunities.site: imdb.com + rottentomatoes.com + local mail compose page
steps: Open IMDb, search for {movie} and open the title page
Record the IMDb rating, director and runtime
Open Rotten Tomatoes, search for {movie} and open the result
Record the Tomatometer percentage
Open the New message form and enter {friend_email} in To
Enter the subject 'Movie night {day}: {movie}'
Enter the body 'Hi {friend}, {day} we watch {movie} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {rating}, Tomatometer {score}%.'
Click Send (in the recording the user clicked Discard each time)

instances.values: Arrival, lena@example.com, Friday -> IMDb 7.9, Tomatometer 94%, Denis Villeneuve, 1h 56m
Spirited Away, tom@example.com, Saturday -> IMDb 8.6, 96%, Hayao Miyazaki, 2h 4m
The Grand Budapest Hotel, aisha@example.com, Sunday -> IMDb 8.1, 92%, Wes Anderson, 1h 39m

opportunities.name: Recipe and dish-origin lookup to Notes
opportunities.description: For a given dish, find a top-rated Allrecipes recipe (rating, total time, servings, key ingredients), look up the dish's place of origin on Wikipedia, then save a summary note.
steps: Open Allrecipes and type {dish} in the search box
Open the first highly rated result
Record the recipe name, rating, total time, servings and the first ingredients
Open Wikipedia, search for {dish} and open the article
Read 'Place of origin' in the infobox
Open the Notes app and add '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe} ({rating} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}'

instances.values: shakshuka -> Chef John's Shakshuka, 4.8 stars, 50 mins, serves 4; origin Ottoman North Africa
pad thai (after an abandoned 'lemon tart' search) -> Pad Thai, 4.0 stars, 45 mins, serves 2; origin Thailand
beef bourguignon -> Classic Beef Bourguignon; origin France
